# About Us

Welcome to Captain Nilesh Holidays, Div. of NILESH GAIKWAD GROUP PRIVATE LIMITED, where every journey becomes a cherished memory. Since last 28 years, we've been dedicated to curating unforgettable travel experiences that redefine the art of exploration. At Captain Nilesh Holidays, Div. of NILESH GAIKWAD GROUP PRIVATE LIMITED, we believe in the transformative power of travel. It's not just about visiting new places; it's about immersing yourself in diverse cultures, forging meaningful connections and creating lifelong memories. Our passion for travel runs deep. What sets us apart is our commitment to Ethical and Sustainable Practices, Reliability and Reputation,Transparent Pricing, Safety and Security and Effortless Travel. Our team of seasoned travel experts works tirelessly to design itineraries that reflect your unique preferences and interests. Whether you're a family of explorers, or a group of friends seeking the ultimate getaway, we've got you covered. But our journey doesn't end there. We're also dedicated to sustainability and responsible travel practices. We believe in leaving a positive impact on the destinations we visit, preserving their natural beauty. Join us on an extraordinary journey where every moment is filled with wonder, and every destination is a new beginning. Let's turn your travel dreams into reality. Welcome to Captain Nilesh Holidays, Div. of NILESH GAIKWAD GROUP PRIVATE LIMITED. Welcome to the experiences of a lifetime.

### Our Backbone

Our travel agency is formed to help you plan and book your dream vacations. By visiting our tour and travel website, you will get to know all domestic and international tour packages we are offering. We have over 28 years of travel planning experience with us !

Whether you're looking for a group tour package or customised package, we have you covered. Simply tell one of our specialists where you want to go, and we'll help you figure out the rest. We work directly with other companies to get the best deals.

### Satisfaction Guaranteed

While working with us, we want you to be completely happy with the experience. If you have questions about us, our services, get in touch! We hope you continue to book with us for many years to come.
